title: Weight Excess Rates for Overweight Bags — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Baggage acceptance terms — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The weight-or-size list charge of a checked bag is multiplied by the **weight excess rate**, which follows the pounds by which the weight counted exceeds the fare brand's weight allowance, when the weight charge is the component recorded. The rate acts on the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

## When the weight charge is the component recorded

The weight charge is zero at or below the weight allowance, the first overweight band fee above the allowance up to the first band limit, and the second overweight band fee above the first band limit; the size charge is zero at or below the standard linear inches of the fare brand and the oversize fee above them, read from the recorded size on the bag charge. The weight charge is the component recorded when it is above zero and at least as high as the size charge.

## The rate

| Situation | Weight excess rate |
|---|---|
| Weight charge recorded, excess of at most 5 pounds (near excess) | 0.5 |
| Weight charge recorded, excess above 5 and at most 20 pounds (middle excess) | 0.8 |
| Weight charge recorded, excess above 20 pounds | 1 |
| Size charge recorded instead | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical allowance of 50 lb)

| Weight counted | Excess | Component recorded | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 55 | 5 | Weight | 0.5 |
| 56 | 6 | Weight | 0.8 |
| 70 | 20 | Weight | 0.8 |
| 71 | 21 | Weight | 1 |
| 60 with a size charge higher than the weight charge | 10 | Size | 1 |
| 75 with equal weight and size charges | 25 | Weight | 1 |
